verdict.rationale: Cline documents linter-aware fixes and a CLI example of running tests and fixing failures, along with general file-editing and terminal-command abilities. Those cover part of the story, but the other named tasks are not specifically documented. Missing for 10: explicit test-authoring workflow, merge conflict resolution, dependency update support, independent hands-on corroboration of these tasks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one-click undo on every step.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.
It can read and write files, run terminal commands, use a browser, and help you build features through natural conversation.
